predecessors.name: Sudan
predecessors.text: the ten southern states: 'South Sudan became an independent state on 9 July 2011' after the January 2011 referendum (98.83% for separation)

ledger.x: 2011: South Sudan becomes independent on 9 July.
2011: Abyei is claimed by both states from independence.

wars.name: Abyei crisis of May 2011
wars.outcome: Sudan seized Abyei with about 5,000 soldiers; South Sudan withdrew its forces; a militarisation deal followed on 20 June 2011 and an Ethiopian UN force (UNISFA) deployed from 27 June 2011.

wars.name: Heglig Crisis
wars.outcome: Sudanese victory: South Sudanese forces withdrew from Heglig after the 20 April order; eight agreements were signed at Addis Ababa on 27 September 2012 (the infobox says 26 September).

wars.name: South Sudanese Civil War
wars.outcome: 'South Sudan descended into the South Sudanese Civil War from 2013 to 2018'; a peace agreement was signed in August 2015, a power-sharing agreement came into effect in August 2018 and Kiir and Machar agreed another deal on 20 February 2020.

certainty.note: The frontier with Sudan follows an administrative line ('the 1931 administrative line' is the test for Heglig) and the 2012 agreements 'on borders and natural resources'; the disputed exceptions, drawn soft, are the Abyei Area, Heglig…
